Trust and Security

Independent audits, documented controls, and the reports your security and legal teams will ask for. Start with the JustCall Trust Center.

Open JustCall Trust Center Request a document
Certifications

Six frameworks, independently assessed

Each one has its own report, and its own request link. Certifications listed here apply to JustCall. ServiceAgent and PyAI are listed by product below.

  • SOC 2Type 2

    Independent audit of security, availability, and confidentiality controls over a full observation period.

    Request SOC 2 report
  • ISO/IEC 270012022

    Certified information security management system, covering how risk is assessed, treated, and reviewed.

    Request ISO certificate
  • PCI DSSv4.0.0

    Payment card data handled to the current PCI standard, including redaction during calls and transcripts.

    Request PCI attestation
  • HIPAAHealth data

    Safeguards for protected health information, with a Business Associate Agreement available for covered entities.

    Request BAA
  • GDPREU privacy

    Data-processing responsibilities, transfer safeguards, and data-subject rights, documented for EU customers.

    Read GDPR guidance
  • CSA STARLevel 1

    Cloud Security Alliance self-assessment, published against the Cloud Controls Matrix.

    View CSA STAR entry
Controls

How your data is protected

The controls behind the certifications, in the order security reviews ask for them.

01

Infrastructure & application security

  • Independent penetration testing on a recurring schedule
  • Vulnerability management with tracked remediation
  • Secure development practices and code review
  • Cloud hosting on AWS and Google Cloud, with security monitoring
The certifications
02

Identity & access

  • Role-based permissions for every team member
  • Multi-factor authentication
  • Single sign-on options
  • Restricted access to sensitive data, logged and reviewed
Data control tools
03

Privacy & data

  • TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest
  • Regular backups and established data-handling procedures
  • Recording retention you set, with automatic deletion
  • Data Processing Agreements and documented AI training-data practices
Transcription and redaction settings
Documentation

The documents behind the controls

Four sets, grouped the way security and legal teams ask for them. Each has its own request link.

01

Compliance reports

SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and CSA STAR documentation.

Request compliance reports
02

Security assessments

Penetration-test summaries, network documentation, and completed security questionnaires.

Request pen-test summary
03

Privacy & legal

Privacy policies, Data Processing Agreements, and HIPAA Business Associate Agreements.

Request DPA or BAA
04

Operational safeguards

Access control, incident response, data retention, and infrastructure policies.

Request policies
By product

What applies to your product

JustCall, ServiceAgent, and PyAI have different scopes. Choose your product for the protections and documents that apply to your deployment.

JustCall

The CRM-friendly business phone system

SOC 2 Type 2, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, PCI DSS v4.0.0, HIPAA, GDPR, and CSA STAR Level 1, with every attestation, certificate, and policy in one place.

  • JustCall Trust CenterAttestations, certificates, and policies
  • Security and complianceControls and vulnerability-reporting guidance
  • GDPR guidanceData-processing responsibilities and data rights
  • Service statusAvailability and published incidents
ServiceAgent

AI front and back office for home-service businesses

How agent setup, business knowledge, and integrations handle your data. Certification scope to be confirmed.

  • ServiceAgent security informationPlaceholder link until the security page is live
  • ServiceAgent Help CenterAgent setup, CRM integrations, and webhooks
PyAI

Speech, voice agents, and telephony as one API

Security reviewed, BAA on Enterprise, and a tamper-evident audit trail for every reviewed call. Certification scope to be confirmed.

  • PyAI security informationPlaceholder link until the security page is live
  • PyAI documentationKeys, scopes, recording controls, and Trace
Questions

The questions security reviews ask

Short answers here. The full detail is in the documents above. Items marked for confirmation are awaiting the security team.

How is data encrypted?

TLS for data in transit and AES-256 for data at rest, across JustCall. Key management details are in the SOC 2 report.

How are backups handled?

Regular backups with established data-handling and restore procedures. Backup frequency and retention period: confirm with security team.

Do you run penetration tests?

Yes, by an independent third party, alongside continuous vulnerability management. Summaries are available on request under NDA.

Where is my data stored, and can I choose a region?

Infrastructure runs on AWS and Google Cloud. Available regions and residency options: confirm with security team.

Who are your subprocessors?

The current list, and how changes are notified, is published in the JustCall Trust Center. Link to the list: confirm with security team.

Will you sign a DPA or a BAA?

Yes. A Data Processing Agreement is available to every customer, and a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement to covered entities. Use the request links under Documentation.

How quickly are customers told about a security incident?

Incident response is documented in the operational policies, and availability incidents are published on the status page. Notification window for data incidents: confirm with security team.

Is there a bug bounty or disclosure program?

Vulnerability reports are accepted through the security and compliance page. Whether a paid bounty applies: confirm with security team.

Trust & security

Have a security question?

Send it to the security team, or report a vulnerability through the security and compliance page.

Contact securityReport a vulnerability
